name: What should I do immediately after my house sustains storm damage?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately after my house sustains storm damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: After ensuring your family's safety, your immediate steps should focus on preventing further damage. Temporarily cover any exposed areas, like broken windows or roof holes, with tarps or boards. Turn off utilities if there's a risk of electrical shorts or gas leaks. Document all damage with photos and videos for insurance purposes before attempting any clean-up. Contact your insurance provider promptly to report the damage and understand your coverage. Then, reach out to a professional restoration company for a thorough assessment and emergency services.
acceptedAnswer.description: First, ensure safety. Then, prevent further damage, document everything, contact your insurance, and call a professional restoration company.
